entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This criminal revision has been preferred by the petitioner/complainant challenging the order dated 04.10.2013 passed by Sessions Judge, Jabalpur, in criminal appeal no.55/2012 affirming the judgment dated 27.07.2011 passed by Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jabalpur in criminal case no.373/2005 whereby the JMFC acquitted the respondents 2, 3 and 4 of the charges under Section 498A of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, against which an appeal was preferred by the petitioner, which was dismissed by the impugned order dated 04.10.2013.
2.
Even after arguing at length, learned counsel for the petitioner has not been able to point out any illegality in the impugned order and judgment passed by the Courts below.

3. Resultantly, criminal revision fails and is hereby dismissed.
4. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
(DWARKA DHISH BANSAL) JUDGE pb NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:26651 2 CRR-6-2014 Smt. Bharti Rai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 April, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70382577/
